body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> Sony presented its 70-inch 120Hz full HD LCD TV during KES 2007, which features 7000:1 contrast ratio and 178-degree viewing angle by using Triluminos LED backlight technology. Adopting three HDMI and USB slot, it supports ‘Bravia Link’ that gives you control for all your Sony product such as TV, Blu-ray disc player and speaker system. It is expected to be released in Japan market on November 20, and suggested price is 4,000,000(JPY).
